findings.implemented: Header/item/footer real slots; conversation/task item identity; existing conversation/chat open commands.
findings.candidate: A typed new-draft command may delegate current App newChat guards if plugin use needs it. Search/sidebar visibility may remain private host controls; add-button extensibility does not require every internal callback to become public.

findings.candidate: Workspace-tab create/select/close needs its own resource target if opened to plugins; do not reuse right-side task workspace context. Existing private invocation lease and prepare/commit authorization must remain.

findings.gap: flow.composer.insertText is publicly typed and called by the sample action, but session dispatch intentionally rejects it and AppActions has no editing port. Slot presence is not functional insertion support.
findings.candidate: Future narrow private draft editing capability must capture target before async activation and recheck full draft ownership/CAS/connection/visibility on commit, including settings-only mutation and A-B-A changes. Never insert into whichever composer is currently focused or duplicate draft state.

findings.implemented: workspace.tabs renders registered panel contributions; selected/visited state and keyboard navigation already have one owner. workspace header/actions/artifact slots mount.
findings.gap: flow.workspace.open only accepts taskId and builtin WorkspaceTabId; it cannot programmatically select an arbitrary registered contribution such as sample.notes.panel.
findings.candidate: A future typed reveal-registered-contribution command can route to the same selection owner. Resolve a current registered panel and valid plugin/context at invocation and after activation; ignore/reject stale disable/version/context transitions, preserve existing visited state and focus behavior. No second panel store, DOM callback or client exposure.

triage: The four slot categories already exist; do not rebuild them or add a generic router.

Right-panel reveal is the smaller functional extension candidate. Composer insertion requires prior draft ownership/CAS interface design and behavior tests. Neither belongs in current Arc20 scope or its pending runtime gate.

Keep root Recovery-action research separate; no duplicate feature proposal. Manager may record these findings under existing plan only, then obtain lawful handoff/fresh exact claim for any implementation.
suggestedFutureAcceptance: Registered panel revealed by contribution ID; unknown/non-panel/inactive IDs rejected; async activation revoked by disable or context replacement does not change current selection.
Keyboard and close focus target remain connected/current; panel selection does not silently change thread/task or reread hidden heavy details.
Composer insertion handles settings-only draft changes, A-B-A ownership replacement, late callback, failed authorization, and preserve-original-draft behavior.
cleanCode: Use existing typed command dispatch, one selection/draft authority and smallest private port. Distinguish mounted slot, declared API and real command implementation.
actions: No project files, tests, PG, HTTP, Chrome, microphone or provider operations. AgentSTOP after bounded read. New command names are proposals, not current APIs.
